description: Binance's public archive (data.binance.vision) for spot pairs: candles back to the year you pick. Each file is checked against its published sha256 and logged in a manifest, then kept current every 6 hours. No keys. Files go to the lake under raw/binance/spot/<instance>, one folder per symbol and interval, as the archive's own zips. Spot times are in microseconds from 2025 on.

intervals.title: Candle intervals
intervals.description: Every interval is its own set of files. 1m rebuilds any other.
intervals.x-note: Per symbol, from the archive's sizes on 2026-10-27: about 2 MB a month at 1m and 43 KB at 1h.
